source: NOIRLab Astro Data Lab TAP, table delve_dr3.decade_shear (DECADE metacalibration shape catalogue, DELVE DR3). Unauthenticated; no credentials are sent.
x_ray_catalogue: Bahar+2022, VizieR J/A+A/661/A7 tables 1 and 2, 542 eFEDS systems, already on disk in ../lead01/ with its own manifests

selection_pass.note: POSITIONS AND REDSHIFTS ONLY -- this pass never requests a shape column, so the sample cannot have been selected on the quantity that is scored

shear_pass.note: metacalibration response recovered per radial bin from the 1p/1m/2p/2m sheared copies; the SELECTION response is not applied, which biases the shear AMPLITUDE by a few per cent but cancels in every ratio reported here

selection.query: SELECT ra,dec,dnf_z,mcal_w_noshear FROM delve_dr3.decade_shear WHERE 't' = q3c_radial_query(ra, dec, 129.532100, 0.417100, 0.919851) AND mcal_flags = 0 AND flags_foreground = 0 AND flags_footprint = 1 AND mcal_sel_noshear > 0 AND dnf_z > 0 AND dnf_z < 3

shear.query: SELECT ra,dec,mcal_g_1_noshear,mcal_g_2_noshear,mcal_w_noshear,dnf_z,mcal_g_1_1p,mcal_g_1_1m,mcal_g_2_2p,mcal_g_2_2m FROM delve_dr3.decade_shear WHERE 't' = q3c_radial_query(ra, dec, 128.510500, 2.577200, 0.275121) AND mcal_flags = 0 AND flags_foreground = 0 AND flags_footprint = 1 AND mcal_sel_noshear > 0 AND dnf_z > 0 AND dnf_z < 3

zenodo_hsc_y3_gama09h: 10.5281/zenodo.15482851 and its two siblings, titled 'HSC Y3 Shape Catalog -- GAMA09H Full Field'.  These describe exactly this field with e1/e2/RA/Dec and are SYNTHETIC: the creator list includes an LLM simulation assistant and the correction notice calls one of them 'an algorithmically scaled or pipeline-derived artifact'.  Not downloaded, not used, not consulted.
